template.name: PlannedMedicationActivityV2
template.desc: This template represents planned medication activities. The priority of the medication activity to the patient and provider is communicated through Priority Preference. The effectiveTime indicates the time when the medication activity is intended to take place. The authorTime indicates when the documentation of the plan occurred.

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="SBADM" (CodeSystem: HL7ActClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.6 STATIC) (CONF:1098-8572).

attribute.name: moodCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @moodCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Planned moodCode (SubstanceAdministration/Supply) urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.11.20.9.24 STATIC 2011-09-30 (CONF:1098-8573).

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: C-CDA R1.1 templateId root without an extension

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] templateId (CONF:1098-30465) such that it

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: SHALL contain at least one [1..*] id (CONF:1098-8575).

element.name: cda:statusCode
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] statusCode (CONF:1098-32087).

choice.desc: Note: This effectiveTime represents either the medication duration (i.e., the time the medication should be started and stopped) or the timestamp when the single-administration should occur.

attribute.name: value
attribute.desc: SHOULD contain exactly one [1..1] @value; Note: indicates a single-administration timestamp

element.name: cda:low
element.desc: SHOULD contain exactly one [1..1] low; Note: indicates when medication started

element.name: cda:high
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] high; Note: indicates when medication stopped

element.name: cda:effectiveTime[@xsi:type='PIVL_TS' or @xsi:type='EIVL_TS']
element.desc: SHOULD contain exactly one [1..1] effectiveTime

element.name: cda:repeatNumber
element.desc:
MAY contain zero or one [0..1] repeatNumber (CONF:1098-32066).
In a Planned Medication Activity, repeatNumber defines the number of allowed administrations. For example, a repeatNumber of "3" means that the substance can be administered up to 3 times.

element.name: cda:routeCode
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] routeCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Medication Route FDA urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.3221.8.7 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-32067).

element.name: hl7:translation
element.desc: The routeCode, if present, SHOULD contain zero or more [0..*] translation, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Medication Route urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1099.12 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-32952).

element.name: cda:approachSiteCode
element.desc: MAY contain zero or more [0..*] approachSiteCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Body Site urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.3221.8.9 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-32078).

element.name: cda:doseQuantity
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] doseQuantity (CONF:1098-32068).

attribute.name: unit
attribute.desc: The doseQuantity, if present, SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] @unit, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet UnitsOfMeasureCaseSensitive urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.1.11.12839 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-32133).

element.name: cda:rateQuantity
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] rateQuantity (CONF:1098-32079).

attribute.name: unit
attribute.desc: The rateQuantity, if present, SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] @unit, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet UnitsOfMeasureCaseSensitive urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.1.11.12839 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-32134).

element.name: cda:maxDoseQuantity
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] maxDoseQuantity (CONF:1098-32080).

element.name: cda:administrationUnitCode
element.desc: MAY contain zero or one [0..1] administrationUnitCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet AdministrationUnitDoseForm urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1021.30 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-32081).

element.name: cda:performer
element.desc:
MAY contain zero or more [0..*] performer (CONF:1098-30470).
The clinician who is expected to perform the medication activity could be identified using substanceAdministration/performer.

element.name: cda:author
element.desc:
SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] Author Participation (identifier: urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.10.20.22.4.119) (CONF:1098-32046).
The author in a planned medication activity represents the clinician who is requesting or planning the medication activity.

element.name: cda:entryRelationship
element.desc: The following entryRelationship represents the priority that a patient or a provider places on the planned medication activity.

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="REFR" Refers to (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002) (CONF:1098-31105).

element.name: cda:entryRelationship
element.desc: The following entryRelationship represents the indication for the planned medication activity.

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="RSON" Has Reason (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002) (CONF:1098-32070).

element.name: cda:entryRelationship
element.desc: The following entryRelationship captures any instructions associated with the planned medication activity.

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="SUBJ" Has Subject (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002) (CONF:1098-32073).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: The precondition, if present, SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="PRCN" Precondition (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002) (CONF:1098-32085).
